gloss: ridge traverse; traversing a mountain range

definitions.gloss: ridge traverse; traversing a mountain range
definitions.explanation: Hiking along a ridge from peak to peak instead of climbing a single summit and coming back down. Also used of a mountain range running lengthwise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{北|きた}→北：00644_kita⟧アルプス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{縦走|じゅうそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{三日|みっか}→三日：02969_mikka⟧かけて⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{縦走|じゅうそう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We spent three days traversing the range.

examples.japanese: {縦走|じゅうそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れた→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{山小屋|やまごや}→山小屋：18402_yamagoya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一晩|ひとばん}→一晩：08887_hitoban⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ことにした。
examples.english: The weather turned partway through the ridge traverse, so we decided to wait a night at the mountain hut.

notes:
{縦|じゅう} (lengthwise) + {走|そう} (run). A mountaineering word: a {縦走|じゅうそう} links several peaks along a ridge, usually over more than one day, staying at mountain huts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縦走|じゅうそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to traverse (a range)
- {縦走|じゅうそう}{路|ろ}: the traverse route
- {全山|ぜんざん}{縦走|じゅうそう}: a traverse of every peak in a range
- {縦走|じゅうそう}⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧: ridge-traverse mountaineering

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧: mountain climbing in general
- ⟦{横断|おうだん}→横断：01906_oudan⟧: crossing — goes across, while {縦走|じゅうそう} follows the length of the range
